visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands wearing clear plastic gloves uses a metal slotted spoon to scoop glossy black grass jelly cubes from a container and places them onto a large mound of creamy, yellow-tinted shaved ice in a light blue bowl. The setting is a clean, indoor kitchen prep area with stainless steel surfaces and bright lighting. (2) A person holds the blue bowl of shaved ice, now topped with jelly, towards the camera. The background shows a vibrant green wall decorated with wooden cat climbing shelves and cat walkways. Two cats are visible roaming on the floor in the slightly blurred background of the cafe interior. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the shaved ice as thick brown sugar syrup and white condensed milk are drizzled over the top of the yellow ice ribbons and black pearls. The textures are rich and wet, with the syrups glistening under the bright indoor shop lights. (4) The camera captures the ice shaving machine in action, producing thin, delicate ribbons of light brown, peanut-flavored ice that pile up into a bowl. The motion is continuous and smooth, highlighting the fluffy texture of the dessert being prepared in a professional setting. (5) Various toppings like cornflakes, crushed peanuts, and peanut powder are sprinkled over the peanut-flavored snow ice. A metal spoon takes a large scoop of the ice, showing the layers of toppings and the airy structure of the shaved ice ribbons. (6) The scene shifts to showing a traditional style of shaved ice topped with assorted colorful ingredients including pineapple, green beans, and small colorful mochi balls. A spoon is seen digging into a separate bowl of soft white bean curd (douhua) topped with red beans and syrup. (7) A wide shot of the cafe interior reveals wooden tables and stools under a green wall with cat shelves. A tabby cat is seen resting on a white table and then yawning in a close-up shot. The space is well-lit and designed for both humans and pets. (8) The final shots show the exterior of the shop '呷大碗 岡山離村店' with a pink banner advertising cats on the second floor. The building is a modern storefront on a city street during the day.
